info.title: Northline Outdoor — MCP tools API
info.description: Northline Outdoor — a sample Shopify storefront (20 products: tents, packs, shells, boots, camp kitchen, sleep + light; lifetime warranty, free US shipping over $75) demonstrating the Busymate AI Shopify app: grounded product/policy chat, an MCP server over the store's own data, WebMCP in-page cart actions, and identified-visitor order lookup.

post.summary: Invoke this demo's MCP tools over JSON-RPC 2.0
post.description: Every tool below is called the same way: POST a JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope with `method: "tools/call"` and `params: {name, arguments}`, where `name` is one of list_products, search_products, get_product, get_order_status, start_return, add_to_cart, view_cart and `arguments` matches that tool's `<name>Args` schema under `components.schemas`. `method: "tools/list"` returns the live catalogue; `method: "initialize"` starts the session.

id.description: Request id, echoed on the response.

params.description: For tools/call: { name: <tool name>, arguments: <that tool's Args schema> }.

200.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 response: {jsonrpc, id, result} or {jsonrpc, id, error}.

list_productsArgs.description: List every product Northline Outdoor sells, with price and stock.

search_productsArgs.description: Search Northline Outdoor's catalog by name or keyword.

query.description: A product name or keyword to search for, e.g. 'rain jacket'.

get_productArgs.description: Get one product's full detail by SKU.

sku.description: The product's SKU code, as shown on its product card.

get_order_statusArgs.description: Look up an order's status and tracking by order number + the email on the order. Call it as soon as a shopper asks about an order — even before they give the number: the call shows an order-lookup card in the chat where they type it. Requires an identified (signed-in) visitor on a real store.

order_number.description: The order number, as printed on the receipt or confirmation email, e.g. '#1042'.

email.description: The email address the order was placed under.

start_returnArgs.description: Start a return for an item on an order. Call it as soon as a shopper wants to return something — the call shows a return card in the chat where they pick the order, the item and the reason. Requires an identified (signed-in) visitor on a real store; this demo does not actually process anything.

order_number.description: The order number the item was purchased on, e.g. '#1042'.

email.description: The email address the order was placed under.

sku.description: The SKU of the item on that order to return.

reason.description: Why the item is being returned, in the customer's own words.

add_to_cartArgs.description: Add a product (by SKU, optionally a specific variant) to this visitor's cart on this page. The cart badge and drawer update immediately.

sku.description: The product's SKU code, as shown on its product card (e.g. TRAIL-SHELL).

qty.description: How many to add. Defaults to 1.

variant.description: Optional variant label like 'Moss / M' or 'Slate'. Defaults to the first in-stock variant.

view_cartArgs.description: Show what's currently in this visitor's cart with line totals, subtotal, shipping and total.
